results.question: How much did I spend on groceries in March 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'groceries') AND substr(posted_date, 1, 7) = '2026-03'

results.question: What was my total spending in January 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND posted_date LIKE '2026-01%'

results.question: How many transactions do I have in total?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM transactions

results.question: What was my single largest purchase?
results.sql: SELECT amount FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' ORDER BY amount LIMIT 1

results.question: How much did I spend on coffee over the whole period?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'coffee')

results.question: How many times did I buy coffee?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions AS t JOIN categories AS c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'coffee' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: What is my average grocery transaction?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'groceries')

results.question: How much total income did I receive?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'income'

results.question: How much did I pay in bank fees?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'fees')

results.question: How much did I spend on rent in total?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'rent')

results.question: How much did I spend between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND posted_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'

results.question: What did I spend in the last three months of the data?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND posted_date >= '2026-05-01'

results.question: How much did I spend on dining in the second half of 2025?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'dining') AND posted_date >= '2025-07-01'

results.question: What is the date of my earliest transaction?
results.sql: SELECT MIN(posted_date) FROM transactions

results.question: What is the date of my most recent transaction?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(posted_date) FROM transactions

results.question: How much did I spend on travel in April 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'travel') AND substr(posted_date, 1, 7) = '2026-04'

results.question: How many months of data do I have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT substr(posted_date,1,7)) FROM transactions

results.question: How much did I spend in December 2025?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND posted_date LIKE '2025-12%'

results.question: Did I spend more on groceries or dining overall?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T.category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'groceries') THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN T.category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'dining') THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) THEN 'dining' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T.category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'groceries') THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T.category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'dining') THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) THEN 'groceries' ELSE 'equal' END AS result FROM transactions T WHERE T.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much more did I spend in April 2026 than in March 2026?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN substr(posted_date, 1, 7) = '2026-04' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(posted_date, 1, 7) = '2026-03' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS spending_diff FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase'

results.question: Which month had the highest total spending?
results.sql: SELECT substr(posted_date,1,7) AS month FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' GROUP BY substr(posted_date,1,7) ORDER BY SUM(amount) ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which category do I spend the most on?
results.sql: SELECT category_id FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY SUM(amount) ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which merchant did I spend the most money at?
results.sql: SELECT merchants.canonical_name FROM transactions JOIN merchants ON transactions.merchant_id = merchants.id WHERE transactions.type = 'purchase' GROUP BY merchants.canonical_name ORDER BY SUM(transactions.amount) ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which merchant do I visit most often?
results.sql: SELECT merchants.canonical_name FROM transactions JOIN merchants ON transactions.merchant_id = merchants.id GROUP BY merchants.canonical_name ORDER BY COUNT(transactions.id) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Was my spending in the first six months higher than the last six?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN posted_date < '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN posted_date >= '2026-01-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) THEN 'no' ELSE 'yes' END AS result FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much less did I spend on dining than on groceries?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T.category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'dining') THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T.category_id = (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'groceries') THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM transactions T WHERE T.type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much did I spend at Amazon?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND merchant_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE canonical_name = 'Amazon')

results.question: How many times did I shop at Target?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM transactions WHERE merchant_id = (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE canonical_name = 'Target') AND type = 'purchase'

results.question: How much do I pay Netflix each month?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS monthly_payment FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND merchant_id = (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE canonical_name = 'Netflix') AND posted_date LIKE '2026-07%'

results.question: How many distinct merchants have I bought from?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase'

results.question: What did I spend at Whole Foods?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND merchant_id = (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE canonical_name = 'Whole Foods')

results.question: How much did I spend on Uber rides?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND merchant_id IN (SELECT id FROM merchants WHERE canonical_name = 'Uber')

results.question: How many subscriptions do I have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.merchant_id) FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE c.name = 'subscriptions' AND t.type = 'purchase'

results.question: Did any of my subscriptions go up in price?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM insights WHERE kind = 'price_hike' AND subject_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'subscriptions')

results.question: What is my most expensive recurring charge?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(typical_amount) FROM recurring_series WHERE active = 1

results.question: How much do my subscriptions cost me per month in total?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_monthly_subscriptions FROM transactions WHERE type = 'purchase' AND category_id IN (SELECT id FROM categories WHERE name = 'subscriptions') AND posted_date BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2026-07-31'
